candidate.definition_en: A brightly colored rubber bag inflated with air or gas, used as a toy or decoration.
candidate.explanation_ar: كيس مطاطي ملون بننفخه هوا أو غاز، بنستخدمه في اللعب والزينة.

senses.definition_en: A brightly colored rubber bag inflated with air or gas, used as a toy or decoration.
senses.definition_ar: كيس مطاطي ملون يُنفخ بالهواء أو الغاز، ويُستخدم كلعبة أو للزينة.
examples: The child cried when his balloon popped.

senses.definition_en: A large bag filled with hot air or gas designed to carry passengers in a basket underneath.
senses.definition_ar: منطاد كبير يُملأ بالهواء الساخن أو الغاز لحمل الركاب في سلة معلقة.
examples: They took a ride in a hot-air balloon.
The child cried when his balloon popped.
They took a ride in a hot-air balloon.
